description:
About the company
 
 Our client is a seed-stage AI company building the data and infrastructure layer that improves model quality in subjective, creative domains, starting with design. It has raised $18.5M and has revenue-generating partnerships with frontier AI labs and application-layer companies. Its products support post-training, reinforcement learning, context and verification.
 
 
 The role
 
 As AI Engineer, RL & Evals, you will build reinforcement learning environments, evaluation frameworks and production infrastructure for creative domains. You will combine backend or full-stack product engineering with applied ML and own systems from design through delivery.
 
 
 What you'll do
 
 • Build and scale RL environments and evaluation frameworks for creative, non-verifiable domains.
 • Design tasks and grading rubrics that capture design quality and taste.
 • Build agent harnesses, context layers and supporting product infrastructure.
 • Collaborate with internal research teams and frontier labs to improve model output quality.
 • Ship production code end to end and build reliable backend systems and data pipelines.
 
 
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 
 • 2-7 years of relevant AI or reinforcement learning engineering experience, with depth building RL environments, evaluation systems or ML post-training systems.
 • Strong full-stack or backend engineering skills and demonstrated production shipping experience.
 • Experience with Python, PyTorch, RL, ML evaluation frameworks and LLMs.
 • Knowledge of distributed systems and data pipelines; relevant scraping, indexing, embedding or agent-harness work is valuable.
 • A computer science degree and fluent English communication.
 • Ability to work in the San Francisco office five days per week.
 
 
 Bonus points
 
 • Experience at creative technology, generative AI, crawling, indexing or data companies.
 • Building agentic frameworks or evaluations for non-verifiable domains.
 • Experience connecting research work to practical products and infrastructure.
 
 
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 
 • $175,000-$275,000 annual base salary.
 • Competitive equity.
 
 
 Location and work model
 
 Full-time, on-site five days per week in Levi's Plaza, San Francisco, California. Visa transfers, including OPT and H1B transfers, are supported.
